en: A black-and-white postcard view of a rural village nestled in rolling hills and fields. Traditional houses with pitched roofs and trees fill the foreground and middle ground, with more homes stretching along a gentle slope in the distance. The landscape is open and pastoral, with low wooded hills on the horizon. At the bottom of the image, there is a white border containing printed script text.
